title: sphaeralcea grossulariifolia
intro: Sphaeralcea grossulariifolia, commonly known as the purple gilia or purple gilia flower, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the mallow family (Malvaceae) and is native to the southwestern United States. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Sphaeralcea grossulariifolia include its ability to act as an anti-spasmodic, reducing muscle spasms and cramps, and its potential to exhibit anti-diarrheal effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
